shields_note: Posted under 'Defensiv Shields' outside the 60: Ultimatum, Aim High, 'Insert Protection', '...' and 'whatever you want to add'; only Ultimatum and Aim High name a shield.
notes: Starting cards as posted under Starting (11): There Is Good In Him, Chief's Hut, Endor DB, I Feel The Conflict, Jedi Luke, AUAoF (starting effect), HFTMF (starting interrupt), Ewok Celebration, Strike Planning, Mob. Points (D2); these count toward the 60.
The post's running totals (11/44/47/55/60) claim 60, but the Starting section lists only 10 cards, so the list as published adds to 59.
Posted 'Mob. Points (D2)' is kept as written: Mobilization Points (Death Star II) is a Dark Side card. The author's strategy update says not to use it and to use Staging Areas instead.
Posted 'Nar Shadda...(Combo?)' dested the combo Nar Shaddaa Wind Chimes & Out Of Somewhere, the only Nar Shaddaa combo of the era.

Posted 'EPP Obi' dested Obi-Wan With Lightsaber; 'Jedi Luke' dested Luke Skywalker, Jedi Knight; 'Endor DB' dested Endor: Landing Platform (Docking Bay); 'Landing Site' dested Endor: Rebel Landing Site (Forest); 'Itorian' dested Ithorian; 'Firin' dested Firin Morett; 'Hojix' dested Houjix; 'Mant. Sarvip' dested Mantellian Savrip; 'Yarna' dested Yarna d'al' Gargan.
'Insert Protection' in the shield list matches no card and reads as a placeholder (with '...' and 'whatever you want to add'), so it has no row.
